No, it's loan fraud. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "贷款诈骗罪" (fraudulent loan). Also could be "职务侵占"? But he is a bank employee using position to illegally obtain loans. Check if any other crime like "职务侵占" (embezzlement) but the act is using false identity to get loan, which is fraud. So final answer.
